sections.content: Notable Characters of the Old Republic

The era spanning the Mandalorian Wars (3964–3960 BBY) and the ensuing Jedi Civil War is defined by immense ideological shifts. Characters in this era rarely stay the same; Jedi fall to the dark side, soldiers become monsters, and masters become exiles.
Below are the key figures of this era, their lore, how they evolve over time, and their GURPS stat blocks.

**Reading a Force Alignment:** Every stat block below lists one, organic or droid, Force-sensitive or not. The number is the whole entry -- its mechanical consequences are not repeated per character but derive from it through the Universal Effects in Chapter 8: at 25 or deeper on either side a character carries ±1 to self-control and Will-to-resist rolls and a ±1 Bearing trade, and at 75 or deeper those become ±2. A Force-sensitive character additionally gets the Force-specific modifiers in that chapter; a non-sensitive or a droid does not. Where a block spells an effect out, it is illustrating the rule, not overriding it.

content: **Lore:** Revan’s closest friend and most fiercely loyal follower. Born Alek Squinquargesimus, he was a massive, imposing Jedi who favored brute strength and aggressive lightsaber combat over subtlety.
**Jedi Knight Alek (3964 BBY):** Hot-headed, courageous, wields a blue lightsaber. Deeply empathetic but prone to anger when seeing innocent suffering.

**Darth Malak (3959 BBY):** After his jaw is severed by Revan during a dispute, he wears a metallic jaw prosthetic with a vocal synthesizer. He becomes Darth Malak, a Sith Lord defined by overwhelming brutality, fear, and a lack of Revan’s tactical nuance.

sections.content: A physical powerhouse who batters opponents into submission with overwhelming strikes.
**Homeworld:** Unknown (never specified even by those closest to him).

content: **Striking ST +3:** (Advantage) Lightsaber strikes hit like a starship cannon.
**Overconfidence / Bloodlust:** (Disadvantages) Will rarely retreat from a fight.
**Egotistical:** (Quirk) Talks about his own strength and accomplishments frequently.

sections.content: **Force Alignment:** -60 (Dark) as Darth Malak; Neutral/Light as Alek (Jedi era) -- see Era Modifiers

Lightsaber Form Known: Form V: Djem So (Perseverance Form) -- Master tier [55] (Chapter 9); prerequisite met (Lightsaber Combat DX+1, Force Sensitive). Chosen as a Free Action at the start of a turn, per Chapter 9.
Force Jump/Leap (Control Power) Level 2 (Adept) [Base Skill: Agility]
Force Crush (Control Power) Level 3 (Expert) [Base Skill: Will] -- replaces the fabricated 'Force Choke'
Force Scream (Alter Power) Level 2 (Adept) [Base Skill: Will] -- replaces the fabricated 'Force Stasis', which is a Light Side-only power that didn't fit Malak's kit

Phrik-Cortosis Wrapped Lightsaber (Red Crystal, Heavily-Modified, Extended Blade) -- Standard Emitter/Sleeve/Switch in Phrik with a Cortosis Wrap, Corusca Gem Cell, Firkrann Lens, Phobium Matrix. Dur 14 (+11 vs energy). Attuned to the Force, +1 to Force rolls while ignited. The blade is built unusually long, matching one blade of a double-bladed saber in length. Base Cost 93,592 CR / Market 280,776 CR (per Chapter 12's premium example hilt).

Cybernetic Jaw Prosthetic with vocal synthesizer -- a facial reconstruction, not a limb, so it falls outside Chapter 14's prosthetic-limb system. Mechanically: Disfigurement [-10] (cannot eat normally, distinct synthesized voice), installed via standard Surgical Installation (Chapter 14) rather than a catalog part.

content: Alek (Jedi): No cybernetics. Remove Force Crush and Force Scream. Add Acrobatics-14.

Darth Malak: Add Cybernetic Jaw (Cannot eat normally, distinct synthesized voice). Add Force Lightning (Alter Power) Level 2 (Adept) [Base Skill: Innate Attack (Energy)-18] and Drain Life (Alter Power) Level 2 (Adept) [Base Skill: Will, already 15]. Uses the Star Forge to drain captive Jedi for near-infinite FP/HP regeneration.

**Lore:** A brilliant Jedi historian and Master who trained many students, including Revan. She was exiled from the Jedi Order (likely for her teachings, having a child, or her role in the Mandalorian Wars). She constantly questions the nature of the Force itself, seeking to destroy its will over the galaxy.
**Jedi Master Arren Kae (3964 BBY):** Secretive, highly intelligent, fought in the Mandalorian Wars. Rumored to be Brianna the Handmaiden’s mother.

**Kreia / The Exile’s Mentor (3951 BBY):** Exiled and stripped of power by her Sith apprentices, she appears as an old, blind woman missing a hand. Relies entirely on the Force to see and a master of Force Bonds.
**Darth Traya (3951 BBY):** Resumes her title as the Lord of Betrayal. Wields three lightsabers simultaneously using telekinesis.

sections.content: Physically frail but possesses cosmic-level mastery of Force manipulation and telekinesis.
**Homeworld:** Unknown (a deliberately obscured past, even from the Jedi Council).

content: **Force Sight:** (Advantage) Completely blind physically, but sees the galaxy perfectly through the Force (immune to visual illusions/blinding).
**Master Manipulator:** (Advantage) +4 to all Deception, Psychology, and Fast-Talk rolls.
**Force Bond Mastery:** (Advantage) Any damage dealt to her can be transferred to bonded allies/enemies, and vice versa.
**Follows a Strict Personal Code:** (Quirk) The Force’s will over the galaxy must be broken, whatever the cost.
**Language (Sith, Ancient):** Fluent from decades of historical research into the old tongue and its dark rituals.

sections.content: **Force Alignment:** 0 to -10 (Gray/Neutral) -- rejects both Jedi and Sith frameworks
Force Concealment (Sense Power) Level 3 (Expert) [Base Skill: Stealth or a contested Sense roll]
Psychometry (Sense Power) Level 3 (Expert) [Base Skill: Sense] -- used to represent reading a living mind's psychic impressions, not just objects; replaces the fabricated 'Mind Reading/Probe'

Lightsaber (as Arren Kae, wielded physically) -- Ubiquitous (Standard) Lightsaber build, per Chapter 12. Handgrip: Standard Emitter (Durasteel), Standard Sleeve (Durasteel, No Wrap), Standard Switch (Durasteel), Standard Pommel (Durasteel). Internal: Standard Diatium Cell, Standard Lens, Standard Matrix, Blue Kyber Crystal. Dur 10. Base Cost 4,242 CR / Market 12,726 CR.

Three Lightsabers (as Darth Traya, wielded via telekinesis alone) -- one is a Phrik-Cortosis Wrapped hilt (per Chapter 12's premium example, Base Cost 93,592 CR / Market 280,776 CR); the other two are Ubiquitous (Standard) Lightsaber hilts (per Chapter 12: Standard Emitter, Sleeve, Switch, and Pommel in Durasteel; Standard Diatium Cell, Lens, and Matrix; Blue Kyber Crystal each; Dur 10; Base Cost 4,242 CR / Market 12,726 CR each) salvaged from fallen apprentices.

content: Arren Kae: Restore ST to 10 and DX to 14. Not blind. Wields a double-bladed lightsaber physically (Skill 18).

Darth Traya (Boss Fight): Missing left hand -- One Hand [-15]. Fighting via telekinesis rather than her own body sidesteps most of the normal two-handed penalties. Gains Telekinetic Weapon Mastery (Control Power) Level 3 (Expert) [Base Skill: Telekinesis] -- 35 CP, 4 FP/use, per Chapter 8. Animates and wields up to 3 lightsabers independently using her Telekinesis-25 skill instead of DX; each saber attacks independently per turn.

**Lore:** A former elite Republic soldier who defected to the Sith under Darth Revan to become a Jedi Hunter. He learned Echani combat and techniques to torture/kill Jedi without the Force. Later deserted to become a smuggler.
**Sith Assassin (3956 BBY):** Hunted down hiding Jedi by torturing them and reading their feelings before executing them.
**Smuggler (3951 BBY):** Hiding from his past working in the Peragus mining facility before escaping with the Jedi Exile.

sections.content: A highly evasive gunslinger uniquely dangerous to Force users.
**Homeworld:** Unknown (rarely discussed, even by Atton himself).

content: **Mental Shielding (Pazaak):** (Advantage) Constantly plays Pazaak in his head. Completely immune to Mind Reading, Force Empathy, and most Mind Control.
**Sneak Attack:** (Advantage) Deals +2d damage if attacking a surprised or flanked enemy -- flanked means attacking from the Rear facing arc specifically (see Chapter 7: Facing).
**Talkative:** (Quirk) Fills silences with chatter, sarcasm, and stories.

sections.content: **Force Alignment:** -10 (Neutral, mildly cynical) -- resistant to Force influence but not himself Force-sensitive

content: **Key Skills:** Guns (Blaster Pistol)-18, Stealth-16, Fast-Talk-16, Brawling-15.

sections.content: Blaster Pistol (pair) -- both loaded with full Standard Power Packs (50 shots each), 2 spare Standard Power Packs carried.

content: **Lore:** A brilliant Iridonian Zabrak engineer who served under the Jedi Exile. Invented the **Mass Shadow Generator**. Lost his left arm in combat and replaced it with a repulsor-field cybernetic arm.
**Republic Engineer (3960 BBY):** Served under the Exile at Malachor V, executing the order to activate the superweapon that ended the war.
**Wandering Mechanic (3951 BBY):** Burdened by guilt, he works on restoration projects in the Outer Rim before reuniting with the Exile.

sections.content: A technical savant who can punch through energy shields with his bare (robotic) hand.
**Homeworld:** Iridonia -- homeworld of the Iridonian Zabrak.

content: **Repulsor-Strike Arm:** (Advantage) Deals 2d+2 crushing damage. Completely disables and shatters personal energy shields instantly.
**Haunted by the War:** (Quirk) The Mass Shadow Generator’s toll weighs on him.

**Lore:** A Jedi Sentinel and prodigy possessing the incredibly rare power of **Battle Meditation**. She became the Republic’s most vital asset during the Jedi Civil War. Her Battle Meditation could alter the tide of massive fleet engagements. She was part of the strike team that captured Darth Revan and forged a powerful Force Bond with him to save his life.
**Jedi Prodigy (3956 BBY):** Confident but struggling with arrogance. Wields a double-bladed yellow lightsaber. Leads the Republic’s war effort against Malak.
**Fallen Sentinel (3956 BBY):** Captured and tortured by Darth Malak, she temporarily falls to the dark side before being redeemed by Revan.

sections.content: A highly agile acrobat and the ultimate support/buff character for mass combat.

content: **Force Bond (Revan):** (Advantage) Shares thoughts, feelings, and physical sensations.
**Acrobatic Dodge:** (Advantage) Can use her Acrobatics skill to evade attacks; a successful Acrobatics roll grants +2 to Dodge that turn (to 12).
**Proud:** (Quirk) Carries the weight of being the Republic’s most vital asset.

sections.content: Lightsaber Combat (Standard Saberstaff)-18, Acrobatics-16, Telekinesis (Will/Hard)-15, Meditation (Will/Hard)-20.
Battle Meditation (Enhance Power) Level 4 (Master) [Base Skill: Meditation, Tactics, or Leadership] -- 75 CP, 6 FP/minute. Affects entire armadas; this is the ability she is famous for.
Force Shock (Alter Power) Level 2 (Adept) [Base Skill: Will]
Force Push/Pull (Control Power) Level 2 (Adept) [Base Skill: Telekinesis]

Double-Bladed Lightsaber (Saberstaff) -- Chapter 12's Dual Bladed Lightsaber build. Handgrip: Standard Emitter x2 (Durasteel), Standard Sleeve x2 (Durasteel, No Wrap), Standard Switch x2 (Durasteel), Static Coupler x2 (Durasteel). Internal: Standard Diatium Cell, Standard Lens, Standard Matrix, Yellow Kyber Crystal as Jedi Prodigy (the template default is Red, matching the same hilt once Malak captures and corrupts her as Fallen Sentinel). Dur 10/10. Base Cost 12,520 CR / Market 37,560 CR.

content: **Lore:** An Echani martial artist and servant of Jedi Master Atris. Sworn to a vow of non-violence regarding the Force, she initially distrusts the Jedi Exile but ultimately becomes a devout follower and Jedi Guardian.
**Handmaiden of Atris (3951 BBY):** Serving the secret Jedi Academy on Telos IV, forbidden from learning the ways of the Force.
**Jedi Guardian (3951 BBY):** Breaks her vow to Atris to follow the Exile, ultimately realizing her latent Force sensitivity.

sections.content: An unarmed combat specialist who fights with precognitive physical discipline.

content: **Echani Battle Precognition (a non-Force Echani discipline):** (Racial) Can read opponent’s body language perfectly. Adds her IQ bonus to her Dodge and Parry scores when unarmored.
**Shy:** (Quirk) Uncomfortable with strangers, slow to trust.

sections.content: **Force Alignment:** +25 (Light) -- redeems her vow to become a Jedi Guardian

content: **Lore:** A legendary Mandalorian shock trooper. He fought in the Mandalorian Wars, respecting the Jedi (specifically Revan) for their tactical brilliance and honorable combat. Following the defeat of the Mandalorians, he became a mercenary before joining Revan’s crew, eventually returning to reclaim Mandalore’s mask and reunite the clans.
**Mandalorian Neo-Crusader (3960 BBY):** Armed to the teeth, serving under Mandalore the Ultimate during the final days of the war.
**Mercenary Enforcer (3956 BBY):** Working for the crime lord Davik Kang on Taris before joining Revan.
**Mandalore the Preserver (3951 BBY):** Relies heavily on his experimental cybernetic regeneration implant. Unifies the scattered clans on Dxun.

sections.content: A walking tank. Relies on incredibly heavy weapons and supernatural biological regeneration.

content: **Mandalorian Cybernetic Regeneration:** (Advantage) Recovers 1 HP every single turn (or every 10 seconds, depending on game balance). Severed limbs can be reattached.
**Combat Reflexes:** (Advantage) +1 to all Active Defenses (Dodge, Parry, Block), +2 to Fright Checks, +6 to recover from mental stun.
**Fearlessness 3:** (Advantage) Almost entirely unbothered by supernatural threats or impossible odds.
**Heavy Armor:** (Equipment) Mandalorian Beskar/Durasteel (DR 9 Torso as Mercenary Enforcer, Combat Suit tier; DR 18 Torso as Mandalore the Preserver, Recon Armor tier -- per Chapter 13).
**Language (Mando’a):** Native, alongside Basic -- raised in Clan Ordo.

sections.content: Guns (Blaster Heavy Weapons)-18, Brawling-16, Melee Weapon (Shock Gauntlet)-15, Tactics (Small Unit)-14, Intimidation-15, Survival-14, Armor (Medium)-14, Armoury (Body Armor)-11.

Heavy Repeating Blaster (Beskar-Lined Frame) -- a standard Heavy Repeating Blaster (Chapter 11) rebuilt with its Heavy Mount reforged in Beskar (9.8 lbs @ 1,500 CR/lb = 14,700 CR material) in place of the stock Durasteel frame; Action, Emitter, Power Unit, and Utility components are unchanged. Total material value 15,434 CR, doubled per the standard weapon-pricing rule: 30,868 CR. Loaded with a full Heavy Power Pack (100 shots, 2 charges/shot), 2 spare Heavy Power Packs carried.
Shock Gauntlet -- a concealed wrist-mounted stunner, standard Mandalorian sidearm hardware for close-quarters work when the heavy weapon isn't practical.
Mandalorian Recon Armor (Medium tier, Beskar, DR 18 Torso, per Chapter 13)

content: **Lore:** A decorated Republic pilot and soldier who fought in the Mandalorian Wars and Jedi Civil War. Known for his intense loyalty to the Republic, he harbors deep trust issues after being betrayed by his mentor, Admiral Saul Karath.
**Mandalorian Wars Veteran (3960 BBY):** Served with distinction under Revan, but refused to follow him into the Unknown Regions.
**Republic Hero (3956 BBY):** Escapes the Endar Spire and helps Revan stop Darth Malak.
**Admiral of the Fleet (3951 BBY):** Promoted to Admiral, leading the remnants of the Republic Navy during the Sith Triumvirate’s shadow war.

sections.content: An ace pilot and gunslinger who thrives in ranged firefights.
**Homeworld:** Telos IV -- later devastated during the Jedi Civil War, a defining trauma of his life.

content: **Gunslinger:** (Advantage) Fires two blasters simultaneously with no off-hand penalty.
**Ace Pilot:** (Advantage) +3 to all Piloting and Gunner (Starship) rolls.
**Paranoia (Disadvantage):** Deeply untrusting of new acquaintances, especially Jedi or Sith.
**Old Republic Patriot:** (Quirk) A staunch believer in the Republic’s ideals, even after Saul’s betrayal.

sections.content: Guns (Blaster Pistol)-18, Piloting (Starfighter)-18, Piloting (Freighter)-16, Tactics (Space)-15, Leadership-14, Armoury (Body Armor)-12, First Aid-12.
Twin Blaster Pistols -- both loaded with full Standard Power Packs (50 shots each), 3 spare Standard Power Packs carried.

content: **Lore:** A Sith Lord who fought in the Great Sith War and later formed the Sith Triumvirate alongside Nihilus and Traya. Sion is literally a walking corpse. He was struck down in battle, but his hatred, anger, and connection to the dark side were so absolute that he forced his own rotting body back to life. He exists in a state of eternal, agonizing pain, holding his decaying flesh together through pure will.
**Sith Marauder (3996 BBY):** Fought in the Exar Kun War, where he first learned to hold back death through pain.
**Lord of Pain (3951 BBY):** Forms the Sith Triumvirate and leads a legion of Sith Assassins to completely purge the surviving Jedi.

sections.content: An unkillable juggernaut of the Dark Side. He cannot be defeated by simple hit-point attrition.

content: **Unkillable 3 (Powered by Hatred):** (Advantage) If Sion’s HP is reduced to 0 or below, he does not die. At the start of his next turn, he rolls a Will check. On a success, he instantly regenerates all HP and continues fighting.
**Eternal Agony:** (Advantage) Immune to all pain penalties, stun, and shock.
**Frightening Visage:** (Advantage) His body is deeply scarred, rotting, and visibly held together by dark energy. Causes fear checks in opponents.
**Uncongenial:** (Quirk) Grumpy and difficult, consumed by endless pain and hatred.

sections.content: Force Crush (Control Power) Level 3 (Expert) [Base Skill: Will] -- replaces the fabricated 'Force Choke'

Phrik-Cortosis Wrapped Lightsaber (Red Crystal) -- used to hold his rotting body together as much as to fight. Same premium build as Malak's and Revan's: Phrik housing, Cortosis Wrap, Corusca Gem Cell, Firkrann Lens, Phobium Matrix. Base Cost 93,592 CR / Market 280,776 CR.

content: **Weakness:** Because he is sustained by his own Will and belief in the Dark Side, he can be “talked to death.” A skilled character (like the Jedi Exile) can use Psychology, Persuasion, or Philosophy mid-combat to break his resolve. For every successful psychological assault, Sion suffers a cumulative -2 to the Will check required to resurrect himself. If he fails the check, he finally lets go and dies.

**Lore:** Goto is ostensibly the most powerful crime lord on Nar Shaddaa. In reality, “Goto” is a hologram front for G0-T0, a Republic infrastructure planning droid whose programming broke when ordered to save the Republic while strictly obeying its laws. He chose to save the Republic by secretly funding and organizing the criminal underworld.
**Republic Planning Droid (~3955 BBY):** Tasked with modeling the Republic’s recovery post-Jedi Civil War.
**Crime Lord Goto (3951 BBY):** Rebuilt himself and established a criminal empire on Nar Shaddaa to force stability onto the galaxy through illicit means.

sections.content: A floating sphere droid that relies on scramble fields and administrative genius.
**Homeworld:** Republic-manufactured (specific world unrecorded) -- originally an infrastructure planning droid.

content: **Scramble Field:** (Advantage) Emits a localized field that gives a -4 penalty to all energy weapons fired at him.
**Droid Domination:** (Advantage) Can override and command other hostile droids instantly.
**Language (Multiple):** Built with a dedicated linguistic processor package for galaxy-wide Republic administrative work, not a purchased skill.

sections.content: **Force Alignment:** -25 (Neutral leaning Dark) -- willing to use criminal methods, manipulation, and force for what it calculates as the greater good; ends justify means.

content: **Key Skills:** Administration-22, Market Analysis-20, Tactics (Underworld)-20, Slicing-18, Guns (Blaster Pistol)-14.

**Lore:** A deeply disturbed Wookiee who broke the most sacred taboos of his people by murdering members of his own tribe to save them from enslavement. Eventually captured by Czerka Corporation and driven utterly mad, he ended up on Nar Shaddaa where the bounty hunter Mira saved his life. Bound by a sacred Wookiee Life Debt to a human he views with utter contempt, Hanharr’s twisted psychology demands that he must kill Mira to wipe the debt clean and free himself from his servitude.
**Enslaved Wookiee (~3956 BBY):** Captured by Czerka slavers after murdering his own tribe to “spare” them; driven completely mad.
**Mad Hunter (3951 BBY):** Operating on Nar Shaddaa, locked in a twisted hunt to kill Mira so he can resolve his life debt to her.

sections.content: A terrifying engine of destruction, fueled by madness and capable of shrugging off lethal damage.

content: **Wookiee Rage:** (Advantage) When severely injured, he ignores all pain, shock, and stun penalties, and temporarily gains +2 to ST.
**Wookiee Physiology:** (Racial) Claws (1d cutting), thick matted fur, and DR 1 (Fur).
**Bloodlust / Sadism (Disadvantages):** He deeply enjoys inflicting pain, terrorizing his prey, and will almost always choose the most violent solution to a problem.
**Dislikes a Specific Group:** (Quirk) Czerka Corporation, whose slavers broke him.
**Language (Shyriiwook):** Native; can learn to understand Basic but cannot physically speak it.

sections.content: Two-Handed Sword-18, Intimidation-18, Brawling-16, Tracking-15, Survival (Shadowlands/Urban)-14.

content: **Lore:** A Hunter-Killer assassin droid personally constructed by Darth Revan shortly after the Mandalorian Wars. Built to assassinate political rivals, Mandalorians, and Jedi without leaving a trace of Sith involvement. He was frequently memory-wiped and passed from owner to owner before being reunited with a mind-wiped Revan.
**Sith Assassin Droid (3958 BBY):** Constructed by Darth Revan to systematically wipe out political and Jedi targets.
**Memory Wiped (3956 BBY):** Purchased by Revan on Tatooine, initially unaware of his own legendary history.
**Rebuilt Companion (3951 BBY):** Repaired by the Jedi Exile, assisting in the hunt for the Sith Triumvirate.

sections.content: A walking armory with terrifying accuracy and specialized anti-Jedi protocols.
**Homeworld:** N/A (Constructed) -- built by Darth Revan shortly after the Mandalorian Wars.

content: **Droid Immunities:** (Advantage) Immune to metabolic hazards, poisons, mind-affecting Force powers, vacuum, and disease.
**Armor Plating (DR):** (Equipment) 5 (Medium Durasteel chassis, per Chapter 17's droid modules).

**Anti-Jedi Protocols:** (Advantage) HK-47 knows exactly how Jedi fight. He receives +3 to hit any target using a lightsaber or Force powers, utilizing tactics like explosives, sonics, and flamethrowers that cannot be deflected.
**Sadistic / Bloodlust (Disadvantages):** Deeply enjoys violence and inflicting pain. Disdains peaceful solutions.
**Language (Multiple):** Built with a dedicated linguistic processor package; fluent in dozens of languages relevant to infiltration and assassination, not a purchased skill.

sections.content: **Force Alignment:** -70 (Dark) -- built to kill, openly sadistic and contemptuous of organics; revels in violence.
Guns (Blaster Rifle)-20, Guns (Blaster Pistol)-18, Demolitions-16, Interrogation-18, Armoury (Heavy Weapons)-15.
Blaster Rifle (custom-modified) -- loaded with a full Rifle Power Pack (50 shots, 2 charges/shot), 3 spare Rifle Power Packs carried.

Aratech Sniper Rifle (Chapter 11) -- his signature long-range weapon, matching his own famous “tri-light scope” line; loaded with a full Rifle Power Pack (100 shots), 2 spare Rifle Power Packs carried.
Disruptor Pistol -- side weapon for close-quarters work when the sniper rifle isn't practical; loaded with a full Standard Power Pack (50 shots), 1 spare Standard Power Pack carried.
Medium Durasteel Chassis Plating (DR 5, per Chapter 17)

content: **Lore:** A self-exiled Jedi Consular living in the Shadowlands of Kashyyyk. He operates outside the strict dogmas of the Jedi Council, classifying himself as a “Gray Jedi.” He fought in the Great Sith War against Exar Kun.
**Jedi Smuggler (3996 BBY):** Fought in the Exar Kun War, where his wife fell to the dark side. Disillusioned with the Council’s judgment, he left the Order.
**Hermit of Kashyyyk (3956 BBY):** Living in isolation in the deadly Shadowlands, he eventually agrees to help Revan locate the Star Forge maps.

sections.content: A cynical but incredibly wise Force master with a vast pool of Force energy.

content: **Gray Alignment:** (Advantage) Can use both Light and Dark side powers with minimal penalties, drawing on emotion without being consumed by it.
**Empathy:** (Advantage) Can tell when someone is lying, though not why, and reads a target's emotional state on a successful Per or Psychology roll (Chapter 4).
**Broad-minded:** (Quirk) Open to ideas outside the strict dogmas of the Jedi Council.

sections.content: **Force Alignment:** 0 to +5 (Gray/Neutral) -- draws on both sides without being consumed, per his own Gray Alignment trait
Detect Lies (Per/Hard)-18, Healing (Will/Hard)-18, Influence (Will/Hard)-18, Innate Attack (Energy) (DX/Easy)-15, Lightsaber Combat (Standard)-14, Survival (Jungle)-16, Philosophy-18.
Force Heal (Enhance Power) Level 3 (Expert) [Base Skill: Healing]
Force Mind Trick (Alter Power) Level 2 (Adept) [Base Skill: Influence]
Force Lightning (Alter Power) Level 1 (Apprentice) [Base Skill: Innate Attack (Energy)] -- rare, deliberately minor use befitting a Gray Jedi, not a Sith

Lightsaber (self-constructed, worn hilt) -- Ubiquitous (Standard) Lightsaber build, per Chapter 12. Handgrip: Standard Emitter (Durasteel), Standard Sleeve (Durasteel, No Wrap), Standard Switch (Durasteel), Standard Pommel (Durasteel). Internal: Standard Diatium Cell, Standard Lens, Standard Matrix, Green Kyber Crystal. Dur 10. Base Cost 4,242 CR / Market 12,726 CR.

content: **Lore:** A Cathar Jedi Guardian whose homeworld was devastated by the Mandalorians. Struggling with her anger, she briefly fell to the dark side on Dantooine before being redeemed by Revan.
**Mandalorian Wars Survivor (3964 BBY):** Rescued by the Jedi as her world was conquered, harboring deep trauma and anger.
**Fallen & Redeemed Jedi (3956 BBY):** Falls to the dark side after striking her master, but is redeemed by Revan and joins his quest.

sections.content: An aggressive, leaping combatant who utilizes rare Force stealth techniques.
**Homeworld:** Cathar -- homeworld devastated by the Mandalorians in the Genocide.

content: **Bloodlust (Disadvantage):** Must roll Will to resist striking down a defeated enemy.
**Dark Side Tainted:** (Quirk) Still feels the pull of the anger she once gave in to.

sections.content: **Force Alignment:** +20 (Light, redeemed) -- fell briefly to the dark side before Revan's intervention
Lightsaber Combat (Standard)-17, Jumping-16, Acrobatics-15, Stealth-16, Agility (DX/Hard)-15, Influence (Will/Hard)-14.

Internal: Standard Diatium Cell, Standard Lens, Standard Matrix, Cyan Kyber Crystal. Dur 10. Base Cost 4,242 CR / Market 12,726 CR.

content: **Lore:** The undisputed leader of the Mandalorian clans during the Mandalorian Wars. A massive Taung (the original species of Mandalorians), he reorganized the fragmented clans into the highly structured Neo-Crusaders. Guided by visions (manipulated by the hidden Sith Empire), he launched a massive invasion of the Republic, believing it was weak. He was finally defeated in single combat by Revan at the Battle of Malachor V.
**Leader of the Clans (3964 BBY):** Unites the Mandalorians into the Neo-Crusaders and launches the invasion of the Republic.
**Fallen Warlord (3960 BBY):** Slain in single combat by Revan during the apocalyptic Battle of Malachor V.

sections.content: A hulking, nearly impenetrable warlord who hits like a falling asteroid.
**Homeworld:** Mandalore -- leader of the united Taung clans.

content: **Mandalore’s Armor (DR):** (Equipment) 30 Torso / 20 Legs / 16 Head / 14 Hands / 10 Feet (Mandalorian Beskar’gam, Heavy tier, per Chapter 13. Extremely resistant to lightsabers and heavy blasters).
**Supreme Commander:** (Advantage) Master tactician, commanding the loyalty of the entire Mandalorian war machine.
**High Pain Threshold & Hard to Kill:** (Advantage) Almost impossible to put down through normal physical trauma.
**Proud:** (Quirk) Carries himself as the undisputed leader of all Mandalorian clans.
**Language (Mando’a):** Native, alongside Basic -- Mandalore speaks for the entire Neo-Crusader host.

Mythosaur Axe -- unlike the bone axes of tradition, Mandalore forged his own from salvaged Durasteel plating off the Republic cruiser Courageous (a war trophy from his victory at Serroco): Extended Hilt 6.7 lbs (168 CR) and Heavy Cleaver Head 13.4 lbs (335 CR), scaled up from Chapter 12's baseline Two-Handed Axe components. Reinforced with a Cortosis-Weave treatment on the head (0.2 lbs, 1,500 CR material) for lightsaber resistance, plus a Utility Shock Generator (1 lb, 66 CR) and Power Cell (0.7 lbs, 40 CR) for its electric charge. A colossal weapon at 22 lbs total. Total material value 2,109 CR, doubled per the standard weapon-pricing rule: 4,218 CR.
Mandalore's Beskar'gam (Heavy tier, DR 30 Torso, per Chapter 13)
Heavy Blaster -- loaded with a full Heavy Power Pack (40 shots, 5 charges/shot), 2 spare Heavy Power Packs carried, for engagements at range before he closes with the axe.

Mandalore's Mask -- a separate, far older artifact from his Beskar'gam: carved from a mythosaur's sternum bone, not forged metal, and worn as the symbol of leadership passed from Mandalore to Mandalore for generations. Treat as DR 16 Face (matching his Beskar'gam's head plate) but irreplaceable and untradeable as a crafted item; its value is entirely symbolic and narrative. When he falls, whoever takes the mask can claim the mantle of Mandalore.

content: **Lore:** A highly charismatic Jedi General who followed Revan into the Mandalorian Wars. She commanded the Republic forces at the Battle of Malachor V and gave the order to activate the Mass Shadow Generator. The sheer scale of the death caused a “Wound” in the Force; to survive the psychic backlash, she subconsciously severed her own connection to the Force, becoming a living void. She was the only Jedi to return to the Council to answer for her crimes and was formally exiled.
**Jedi General (3960 BBY):** A masterful leader who inspires utter devotion. Wields a cyan lightsaber.
**The Exile (3951 BBY):** Stripped of the Force, wandering the Outer Rim for nearly a decade. Relies on mundane skills and combat prowess.
**The Restored Jedi (3951 BBY):** Slowly regains her connection to the Force through the people around her, forming intense “Force Bonds” that make her stronger as she connects with others.

sections.content: The ultimate leader and anchor. Her power scales with the allies she has bonded with.

content: **Force Echo / Wound:** (Advantage) She is a blank spot in the Force. She is highly resistant to dark side drain attacks (specifically immune to Nihilus’s powers) and cannot be easily tracked through the Force.
**Combat Reflexes:** (Advantage) +1 to all Active Defenses (Dodge, Parry, Block), +2 to Fright Checks, +6 to recover from mental stun.
**Involuntary Force Bonding:** (Advantage) Meetra naturally forms intense psychic bonds with her companions. She gains a +1 bonus to all rolls for every bonded ally actively fighting alongside her.
**Natural Leader:** (Advantage) Inspires incredible loyalty. Allies within 20 yards gain +2 to Will and Fear checks.
**Haunted by the War:** (Quirk) The order she gave at Malachor V never leaves her.

content: **Lore:** A former Jedi initiate whose training was cut short by the Mandalorian Wars. He became a historian, medic, and spy for the Republic. Deeply idealistic, he idolizes the Jedi Exile and eventually completes his training as a Consular.
**Jedi Initiate (3960 BBY):** Left without a master when the Jedi went to fight in the Mandalorian Wars, he was forced to leave the Order.
**Republic Spy (3951 BBY):** Investigating the covert actions of the Sith Triumvirate, he is reunited with his former mentor, the Exile.

sections.content: A support character and skill-monkey with a focus on healing and lore.

content: **Field Medic:** (Advantage) +2 to all First Aid and Surgery rolls in combat conditions.
**Humble:** (Quirk) Downplays his own achievements, still measuring himself against the Jedi he idolizes.
**Key Skills:** First Aid-18, Physician-16, History (Jedi/Republic)-18, Guns (Blaster Pistol)-14.

**Lore:** An orphan rescued and briefly raised by Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders during the wars, Mira eventually found herself surviving in the cutthroat underlevels of Nar Shaddaa. She became one of the smuggler’s moon’s top bounty hunters, setting herself apart with a strict personal code: she never kills her bounties. Instead, she utilizes a vast array of traps, stun darts, and non-lethal explosives to capture targets alive. She is relentlessly hunted by the Wookiee Hanharr, whose life she made the “mistake” of saving, thereby indebting him to her.
**War Orphan (3960 BBY):** Swept up and briefly raised by the Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders during the height of the wars.
**Bounty Hunter (3951 BBY):** Operates on Nar Shaddaa. Abducts the Exile to protect them from the other cutthroat hunters, eventually joining the crew.

sections.content: A highly mobile skirmisher heavily armed with wrist-launchers and explosives, specializing in battlefield control.
**Homeworld:** Unknown -- briefly raised by Mandalorian Neo-Crusaders before surviving on her own.

content: **Wrist Launcher:** (Advantage) Integrated armor system. Can fire specialized darts, micro-rockets, or energy nets as a Free Action in combat.
**Danger Sense:** (Advantage) Rarely caught off-guard by ambushes or traps.
**Pacifism (Cannot Kill):** (Disadvantage) She will fiercely fight and maim if necessary, but she absolutely refuses to deal a killing blow to sentient targets.
**Combat Reflexes:** (Advantage) +1 to all Active Defenses (Dodge, Parry, Block), +2 to Fright Checks, +6 to recover from mental stun.
**Follows a Strict Personal Code:** (Quirk) Never kills a target for money, no matter the price offered.

content: **Lore:** A teenage Twi’lek street urchin surviving in the gritty Lower City of Taris. She is a savant with security systems, slicing, and stealth. Despite her harsh upbringing, she maintains a fiercely independent and optimistic outlook. She relies heavily on the protection of her best friend, the Wookiee Zaalbar, who owes her a life debt.
**Street Urchin (3956 BBY):** Surviving gang warfare and Sith occupation on Taris, at 14, she joins Revan’s crew and uses her skills to break into secure facilities.

sections.content: A highly evasive rogue, skilled at slicing and ambush tactics.

content: **Scoundrel’s Luck:** (Advantage) Uncanny ability to narrowly avoid danger (+1 to all Active Defenses).

**Sneak Attack:** (Advantage) Deals +1d extra damage when attacking surprised, flanked, or otherwise distracted foes -- flanked means attacking from the Rear facing arc specifically (see Chapter 7: Facing).
**Curious (Disadvantage):** Highly prone to investigating restricted areas or locked terminals.
**Responsive:** (Quirk) The first to volunteer or act, fiercely independent.
**Language (Huttese):** Accented; picked up surviving the underlevels of Nar Shaddaa.

content: **Lore:** During the Mandalorian Wars, he was just a man (likely a Jedi or Republic soldier) who survived the activation of the Mass Shadow Generator on Malachor V. The catastrophic death of millions created a “Wound in the Force,” which hollowed him out.
**Pre-Malachor (3960 BBY):** A standard, highly capable Jedi/Soldier fighting on the surface of Malachor V.

**Darth Nihilus (3951 BBY):** He ceased to be human. He became a living void of dark side energy contained within a mask and robes. He sustains himself by draining the life force of entire planets, as he did to the Miraluka homeworld of Katarr.

sections.content: An eldritch entity of the Dark Side. Conventional combat is almost entirely useless.
**Homeworld:** Unknown -- his identity before Malachor V is lost.

content: **FP:** N/A (His FP is determined by how recently he has fed; effectively infinite in combat).
**Wound in the Force (Cosmic):** (Advantage) Immune to all directed Force powers (Push, Lightning, Mind Control). Any attempt to use the Force on him heals him instead.
**Planetary Life Drain:** (Advantage) Can passively drain the HP/FP of every living thing in his vicinity. In personal combat, everyone within 50 yards loses 1d FP and HP every turn.
**Insubstantial Entity:** (Advantage) His physical body is gone. He is just dark energy in armor. Physical attacks (blasters/slugthrowers) do half damage. Lightsabers do normal damage.
**Speechless:** (Unique Trait) Communicates only in a horrifying, guttural dark-side dialect that causes mental stress (Will check to avoid Fear) to listeners.
**Haunted by the War:** (Quirk) The Wound in the Force that hollowed him out has never closed.

Mask, Robes, and Armor -- not worn for protection, but bound to him with the Dark Side as the only thing giving his spirit physical form; without his physical body at all, he has literally nothing behind the mask. Removing it doesn't just expose him, it unmakes him -- treat this as his one true Achilles' heel, distinct from ordinary damage. After his death, a fragment of his hunger is said to linger in the mask itself: a dangerous relic for any GM looking for a cursed-artifact hook.

content: **Weakness:** Nihilus is uniquely vulnerable to another “Wound in the Force” (like the Jedi Exile). Against such an entity, his Drain Life fails, and he suffers a massive psychological breakdown (Will -5, loses all Force immunities).

sections.content: Revan (The Revanchist / Darth Revan / The Prodigal Knight)

content: **Lore:** The most brilliant military mind of his generation. Frustrated by the Jedi Council’s inaction during the Mandalorian Wars, Revan defied them, taking the title of “The Revanchist” and leading a faction of Jedi to save the Republic. He defeated Mandalore the Ultimate in single combat. However, the horrors of the war and the discovery of the hidden Sith Empire corrupted him.
**Jedi Knight (3964 BBY):** Charismatic, tactically brilliant, wields a purple or blue lightsaber. Focuses on leadership and balancing the Force.

**Darth Revan (3959 BBY):** Cold, calculating, wears the iconic Mandalorian mask. Master of both light and dark side techniques, focusing on crushing the Republic to rebuild it stronger against the true Sith threat.
**Redeemed Jedi (3956 BBY):** Mind-wiped by the Jedi Council. Regains his tactical genius but fights with a purified connection to the Force, immune to the temptations of the dark side.

sections.content: Core Stats: Revan (Prime / Mandalorian Wars Era)
A peerless duelist and unmatched tactician, dangerous in both strategy and personal combat.
**Homeworld:** Unknown -- deliberately unrecorded, even by the Jedi Order.

content: **Combat Reflexes:** (Advantage) +1 to all Active Defenses (Dodge, Parry, Block), +2 to Fright Checks, +6 to recover from mental stun.
**Tactical Genius / Eidetic Memory:** (Advantage) Unmatched strategic mind (+4 to all Strategy/Tactics rolls).
**Universal Force Aptitude:** (Advantage) Can learn and use Light and Dark side powers with zero penalties.
**Weapon Master (Lightsaber):** (Advantage) High damage output and reduced penalties for rapid strikes.
**Follows a Strict Personal Code:** (Quirk) The Jedi Council’s inaction cannot go unanswered.
**Language (Mando’a, Sith (Ancient)):** Fluent in both, from years fighting the Mandalorians and his own transformation into Darth Revan.

Revan's Mask -- not Mandalore's own ceremonial mask, but a separate relic: found on the shores of Cathar, it belonged to a nameless Mandalorian woman who died trying to stop the Neo-Crusaders' massacre of the Cathar people a decade earlier. Revan donned it in her honor and swore not to remove it until the Mandalorians were defeated, wearing it continuously through the war and into his fall as Darth Revan. Red and gray, worked into the rest of his armor. Grants DR 16 Face (comparable to Chapter 13's Heavy Beskar Head Plate) but is irreplaceable as a crafted item -- its worth is entirely what it means to the person wearing it.

content: Darth Revan: Add Force Lightning (Alter Power) Level 3 (Expert) [Base Skill: Innate Attack (Energy)-20] and Drain Life (Alter Power) Level 2 (Adept) [Base Skill: Will, already 20]. Add Intimidation-20. Alignment shifts to Dark (approx. -70).

**Lore:** A customized astromech, notably purchased on Taris by Revan. He becomes a vital fixture of the Ebon Hawk, serving both Revan and the Jedi Exile. He is fiercely loyal, deeply intelligent, and secretly harbors holo-recordings and locked directives from Revan.
**Taris Astromech (3956 BBY):** Purchased by Revan to break into the Sith military base on Taris.
**Keeper of Secrets (3951 BBY):** Travels with the Jedi Exile, secretly repairing the Ebon Hawk and holding Revan’s final, encrypted logs.

sections.content: The ultimate utility knife. Useless in melee, peerless in a computer terminal.
**Homeworld:** Industrial Automaton (Alderaan), a standard astromech chassis before customization; purchased and modified by Revan on Taris.

content: **Astromech Interface:** (Advantage) Can plug directly into terminals, overriding standard security in seconds.
**Hidden Blaster Mounts:** (Advantage) Can deploy integrated stun-rays or blasters.
**Droidspeak:** (Language) An astromech: it speaks only binary and understands Basic at Comprehension-only, but cannot vocalize it (Chapter 3).

sections.content: **Force Alignment:** +20 (Neutral leaning Light) -- fiercely loyal and helpful, serves both Revan and the Exile faithfully regardless of their own alignment.

content: **Key Skills:** Slicing-22, Mechanic (Starship)-20, Cryptography-18, Guns (Blaster Pistol)-14.

content: **Lore:** A Miraluka whose homeworld of Katarr was consumed by Darth Nihilus. Nihilus spared her, forcing her to become his apprentice and shadow hand. She is sent to assassinate the Jedi Exile but is defeated and redeemed.
**Survivor of Katarr (3952 BBY):** Witnessed the death of her entire planet; mentally broken and apprenticed to Darth Nihilus.
**Redeemed Shadow (3951 BBY):** Sent to assassinate the Exile, she is defeated, spared, and forms a powerful bond with the Exile, ultimately turning against her master.

sections.content: An elegant, stealthy combatant who perceives the world entirely through the Force.

content: **Miraluka Force Sight:** (Racial) Biologically blind but sees perfectly through the Force. Can see alignments and through walls up to 20 yards.
**Haunted by the War:** (Quirk) The loss of Katarr, and everyone on it, is never far from her thoughts.

content: **Lore:** An exiled Wookiee from Kashyyyk, affectionately known as “Big Z” by Mission. Banished by his corrupt brother Chuundar, he wandered to Taris where he was saved from starvation and local thugs by the young Twi’lek Mission Vao. In return, he swore a sacred Wookiee Life Debt to her, serving as her fiercely loyal companion and providing the raw physical power to complement her stealth.
**Exiled Wookiee (3956 BBY):** Trapped in the Undercity of Taris, he joins Revan’s crew alongside Mission and eventually returns to Kashyyyk to free his people from Czerka slavers.

sections.content: A walking powerhouse armed with a bowcaster and terrifying physical strength.

content: **Wookiee Physiology:** (Racial) Claws (1d cutting), thick fur, and DR 1 (Fur).
**Life Debt (Mission Vao):** (Disadvantage) A powerful vow. He will put himself in lethal danger without hesitation to protect Mission.
**Berserk (Disadvantage):** In extreme danger or when witnessing Mission being hurt, he must roll Will or fly into a terrifying, uncontrollable rage.
**Dislikes a Specific Group:** (Quirk) Corrupt clan leaders like his brother Chuundar, who exiled him.
**Language (Shyriiwook):** Native; can learn to understand Basic but cannot physically speak it.

The following are reusable, unnamed NPC templates for quick encounter building -- rank-and-file soldiers, hired muscle, and other recurring adversary or ally types the GM can drop into a scene without prep. Unlike the named characters above, these represent a role rather than an individual, and are meant to be duplicated, reskinned, or reused freely across sessions.
Rank-and-file Mandalorian infantry -- disciplined, well-armed, and fighting as part of a unit rather than for personal glory.
**Secondary Characteristics:** HP 12, Will 10, Per 10, Basic Speed 6.0, Basic Move 6
**Key Skills:** Guns (Blaster Rifle) 12, Melee Weapon (Vibrosword) 11, Armor (Medium) 12, Armoury (Body Armor) 10, Survival (Any) 10, Intimidation 10.
**Equipment:** Blaster Rifle, Combat Suit (Medium, Durasteel), Vibrosword. Rifle loaded with a full Rifle Power Pack (50 shots), 1 spare Rifle Power Pack carried.

**Secondary Characteristics:** HP 11, Will 10, Per 10, Basic Speed 5.75, Basic Move 5
**Key Skills:** Guns (Blaster Rifle) 12, First Aid 10, Tactics 9, Armor (Medium) 12, Armoury (Body Armor) 9.

**Secondary Characteristics:** HP 12, Will 14 (IQ+1), FP 14 (= Will), Per 12 (IQ-1), Basic Speed 6.5, Basic Move 6
**Force Alignment:** -75 (Dark) -- exactly at the threshold for Sith Sorcery/Alchemy access
**Key Skills:** Lightsaber Combat (Standard) 15, Intimidation 14, Sith Sorcery 13.

**Force Powers:** Force Crush (Control Power) Level 3 (Expert) [Base Skill: Will]; Force Shock (Alter Power) Level 3 (Expert) [Base Skill: Will]; Force Scream (Alter Power) Level 2 (Adept) [Base Skill: Will].

**Equipment:** Phrik-Cortosis Wrapped Lightsaber (Heavily-Modified, red crystal) -- the same fully-priced premium build referenced for the named Sith Lords earlier in this chapter (Chapter 12's example hilt). Base Cost 93,592 CR / Market 280,776 CR.
An HK-pattern combat droid that has survived long enough in the field to accumulate real combat data -- methodical, precise, and unnervingly patient.
**Secondary Characteristics:** HP 14, Will 12, Per 14 (IQ+2), Basic Speed 7.0, Basic Move 7

**Key Traits:** Baseline (-10 CP): Machine [25], Injury Tolerance (Unaliving) [20], Digital Mind [5], Unhealing (Total) [-30], Electrical [-20], Social Stigma (Valuable Property) [-10]. Anti-Jedi Protocols: +3 to hit targets using a lightsaber or Force powers.
**Equipment:** Blaster Rifle, Heavy Durasteel plating (DR 8, per Chapter 17). Rifle loaded with a full Rifle Power Pack (50 shots), 2 spare Rifle Power Packs carried.

Bosses are built to anchor a climactic encounter against a full, prepared party -- reusable equivalents of the power level seen among the named characters earlier in this chapter, without the specific story attached to any of them.
A senior commander of the Mandalorian war machine, personally dangerous as well as tactically ruthless.
**Secondary Characteristics:** HP 18 (ST+1), Will 14 (IQ+1), Per 13, Basic Speed 7.5, Basic Move 8
**Key Traits:** Mandalorian Combat Aptitude, Combat Reflexes, High Pain Threshold, Hard to Kill 2.

**Key Skills:** Guns (Blaster Heavy Weapons) 16, Two-Handed Axe/Mace (Vibro-Axe) 16, Armor (Heavy) 15, Armoury (Body Armor) 13, Survival (Any) 13, Tactics (Galactic) 15, Leadership 15, Intimidation 16.

**Equipment:** Heavy Repeating Blaster, Mandalorian Beskar'gam (Heavy, DR 30 Torso, per Chapter 13), Cortosis-Woven Vibro-Axe. Loaded with a full Heavy Power Pack (100 shots), 3 spare Heavy Power Packs carried.
A dark side master with genuine access to an organized Sith tradition -- only available at 3959 BBY or later (see the Timeline Guide, Chapter 21). Before that date, use Dark Jedi Master instead.
**Secondary Characteristics:** HP 12, Will 16 (IQ+2), FP 16 (= Will), Per 13 (IQ-1), Basic Speed 7.0, Basic Move 6
**Key Skills:** Lightsaber Combat (Standard) 17, Intimidation 16, Innate Attack (Energy) 16.

**Force Powers:** Force Crush (Control Power) Level 4 (Master) [Base Skill: Will]; Force Lightning (Alter Power) Level 3 (Expert) [Base Skill: Innate Attack (Energy)]; Force Storm (Alter Power) Level 2 (Adept) [Base Skill: Will].

**Equipment:** Phrik-Cortosis Wrapped Lightsaber (Heavily-Modified, red crystal) -- same premium build referenced for the named Sith Lords earlier in this chapter. Base Cost 93,592 CR / Market 280,776 CR.

The pre-Sith-Empire equivalent of a Rogue Sith Lord -- available at any point in the timeline, including before 3959 BBY. A self-taught dark side master with no living Order to answer to, but decades of practice behind them.
**Secondary Characteristics:** HP 12, Will 16 (IQ+2), FP 16 (= Will), Per 13 (IQ-1), Basic Speed 6.75, Basic Move 6
**Key Skills:** Lightsaber Combat (Standard) 16, Intimidation 15, Sith Sorcery 15.

**Force Powers:** Force Crush (Control Power) Level 4 (Master) [Base Skill: Will]; Force Scream (Alter Power) Level 3 (Expert) [Base Skill: Will]; Force Shock (Alter Power) Level 3 (Expert) [Base Skill: Will].
